concepts.label: new pattern
concepts.title: Event-driven status
concepts.summary: A status change is sent as a small event the moment it happens, instead of waiting for the weekly batch. It replaces the spreadsheet round trip.

concepts.label: new component
concepts.title: Aggregator
concepts.summary: A worker that reads status events and writes the latest status and the history. It does not serve pages; the API does.

concepts.label: behavior change
concepts.title: Status history, no overwrite
concepts.summary: Before, an update overwrote the old status. Now every update adds a row, so reports can show what changed and when.
